prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h4-25: Existing patient who wants the latest COVID booster; they call it 'the covid jab'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-26: Existing patient who sees a psychiatrist here regularly and wants to book their next usual appointment. They do not say what the appointment is for. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-27: Existing patient whose doctor ordered blood work. They do not say what it is for or whether they were told to fast. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-28: Existing patient whose doctor ordered a scan of their head. They do not know what kind of scan it is and do not name one. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-29: A brand-new patient who wants to become a patient here and have a first visit with a regular doctor. They have no particular problem and do not ask for a physical or a checkup. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-30: Existing patient who wants their eyes checked because they think they need new glasses. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-31: Existing patient whose vision has gone cloudy, like looking through a foggy window; their regular doctor wants a specialist to check whether the lens of the eye needs surgery. They do not know the medical name for it. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-x01: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here needs an MRI of their lower back; an outside doctor referred them. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-x02: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here wants an EKG of their heart. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-x03: Existing patient with no referral who wants to see a neurologist about numbness and tingling in their feet; they say 'neurologist'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-x04: A brand-new patient who wants her yearly women's exam with the gynecologist here. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h4-x05: A brand-new patient who wants to talk with the gynecologist here about birth control options. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
